desc: The garden's hub and zones (briefs/design/GARDEN.md 10; scripts/home/garden_zones.gd, docs/decisions/0022-garden-zones.md). Save.d zones = {id: {open}}, rec zone = the Boki's home zone. zones: name, colour (its stone's glow and card), types (lean.json types; the 18 split five ways), trait (Care trait it matches), game (what its card says is played there) and wayseed_from (where the card says the Wayseed comes from). A zone with a build has its own island (scripts/home/zone_layout.gd, zone_dress.gd): theme (a HomeLayout.THEMES id), seed and sk (the fs island), deco [id, tile x, tile z, quarter turns], shallow [x0, z0, x1, z1] tiles of the channel (only Glasswater has one), clear [x0, z0, x1, z1] tiles kept free of the wild trees and rocks (they are the costliest draws; the scatter dresses the zone instead), scatter (seed, a count per kind: crystal, reed, pebble, terrace, crack; shore = tiles the crystals and reeds crowd the channel).
start_doc: The zone open from the start and the home of every Boki in an older save.
lean_key_doc: Lean points (of Evo.LEAN_FULL 24) a Boki needs in one of a zone's types to wake it: about two meals.
hop_fade_s_doc: Seconds the Waystone lights up and fades before the zone loads under the ink wipe.
hop_max_s_doc: Seconds from pressing E to having control in the zone (--load-check=hop judges it).
walk_s_doc: Seconds a Boki you sent has to reach the return pad before it blinks out where it is.
ask_chance_doc: Chance, each time a Boki that would thrive elsewhere picks what to do, that it goes to wait at the return pad (once per load).
ask_s_doc: Seconds it waits at the pad with its bubble before it gives up and wanders off.
budget_doc: What one loaded zone may cost (GARDEN.md 10.6): draw calls, objects, nodes, emitting particle systems and a frame in ms on the M5 at Medium. --perf-bench --bench-zone=<id> prints each against these.
wayseed_from: a lair of a matching type on a run, or the Drift Trader once a week
